room_description: A grimy, yellow-tiled basement or locker room with blood stains, a skeleton, and various cleaning equipment.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the grimy room.
Finding a mop and a bucket on the blood-stained checkered floor.
Inspecting a skeleton holding a leather briefcase.
Finding a hidden number '1354' written in blood on the wall tile.
Entering '1354' into the briefcase combination lock.
A small monitor on the wall flashes a sequence of Red, White, Yellow, Green.
Pressing the buttons on the trash bins in the order shown by the monitor.
Using a hooked pole to retrieve an object from the ceiling rafters.
Checking the generator/pump in the corner of the room.
Activating the generator to open the exit door.

solution_steps: Use the mop to clear away grime or blood to reveal the code 1354 on the wall.
Enter 1354 into the briefcase lock next to the skeleton.
Observe the color sequence on the wall monitor (Red, White, Yellow, Green).
Press the corresponding color-coded lids of the four trash bins in the same order.

final_action: Using the duct tape to repair a frayed wire and turning the red valve on the generator to unlock the door.
